newsitem.title: DUBAI: Qatar condemns Jerusalem tunnel opening.
newsitem.headline: Qatar condemns Jerusalem tunnel opening.

text.p: The Gulf Arab state of Qatar said on Wednesday Israel had provoked Moslems by opening a tunnel in Jerusalem beside the Temple Mount, site of Islam's third holiest site.

The cabinet said in a statement, carried by the official news agency, that Israel's move was "a challenge to the feelings of Moslems and an act that violates the peace accord as well as international decisions on Jerusalem...which could put the peace process in great danger."

Palestinians clashed with police in Jerusalem on Tuesday after workmen opened the tunnel under cover of night. The PLO said the tunnel is part of a programme to Judaise Jerusalem and the Arab League has warned it will ignite Arab anger.
